title: Same Layout, Different Count: What Number Words Do Past Ten in Text-to-Image Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.06840v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ask SD3.5-Medium for twelve of an object and then, from the same starting noise, for twenty-five. The picture keeps its layout, but the count changes about as much as it would under a new random seed, and in no consistent direction. We study what number words do once a request passes about ten objects, in five open text-to-image models. Holding the object and the starting noise fixed, we change one thing at a time, and people who never see the request count 3,088 of the images. Every model follows the number for small crowds, but only up to a point, its reach: SD3.5-M and FLUX.1-dev stop following it soon after ten, while FLUX.2 [klein] and Qwen-Image follow it loosely up to twenty-five. translated_title: 布局相同，数量不同：数字词在文生图模型中超过十之后的作用
translated_abstract: 让SD3.5-Medium生成十二个某个物体，然后在相同的起始噪声下请求二十五个。图像保持其布局，但物体数量的变化幅度与更换随机种子时相当，且没有一致的方向。我们研究了在五个开源文生图模型中，当请求的物体数量超过约十之后，数字词究竟起什么作用。在固定物体和起始噪声的前提下，我们每次只改变一个变量，并由从未见过请求文本的人员对其中3,088张图像进行了计数。每个模型在数量较小时都能遵循数字指令，但只到某个限度，即其“可达范围”：SD3.5-M和FLUX.1-dev在超过十之后很快不再遵循数字，而FLUX.2 [klein]和Qwen-Image则能大致遵循到二十五。超出SD3.5-M的可达范围后，起始噪声的粗粒度部分决定了图像的构图，但并不决定其中物体的数量：仅重绘比图像八分之一更精细的噪声，既能像新的数字一样保持布局，并且已经……
tldr: 该研究通过3,088张图像的人工计数发现，文生图模型仅在各自特定的“可达范围”内（约十至二十五）遵循数字词指令，超出该范围后图像布局由起始噪声的粗粒度部分固定，而仅重绘细粒度噪声即可像更换数字一样改变画面中的物体数量。
en_tdlr: Through human counting of 3,088 images, this study shows that text-to-image models follow number words only up to a model-specific "reach" (roughly ten to twenty-five), beyond which the layout is fixed by the coarse part of the initial noise, and redrawing only the fine-scale noise changes the object count as much as changing the requested number does.
